import json
import random
import sys
import time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/work')
from harness import run, check_plan

FAIL = []


def expect(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        FAIL.append(name)
        print('FAIL %s\n  got  %s\n  want %s' % (name, json.dumps(got, sort_keys=True),
                                                json.dumps(want, sort_keys=True)))
    else:
        print('ok   %s' % name)


# participants 0,1,2 with ordinary forwarders 3 and 4:  0-3-1-4-2
LINKS = [[0, 3, 10], [3, 1, 10], [1, 4, 10], [4, 2, 10]]
reqs = [
    {"op": "load", "n": 5, "links": LINKS, "bookings": []},
    {"op": "prepare", "id": "p1", "owner": "a", "window": [0, 10], "period": 1,
     "participants": [[0, 1], [1, 1], [2, 1]], "envelope": [[0, 2], [1, 2], [2, 3]],
     "rev": 0},
]
out = run(reqs)
expect('prepare status', out[1]["status"], "prepared")
if out[1]["status"] == "prepared":
    ok, why = check_plan(out[1]["plan"], 5, [(0, 3), (3, 1), (1, 4), (4, 2)],
                         {0: 2, 1: 2, 2: 2, 3: 2}, [0, 1, 2], {0: 1, 1: 1, 2: 1}, 1,
                         {0: 2, 1: 2, 2: 2, 3: 2})
    expect('plan valid (%s)' % why, ok, True)

# tight capacity: not admissible
reqs = [
    {"op": "load", "n": 5, "links": LINKS, "bookings": []},
    {"op": "prepare", "id": "p1", "owner": "a", "window": [0, 10], "period": 1,
     "participants": [[0, 1], [1, 1], [2, 1]], "envelope": [[0, 1], [1, 1], [2, 1], [3, 1]],
     "rev": 0},
]
out = run(reqs)
print('tight capacity reply:', json.dumps(out[1])[:400])
if out[1]["status"] == "denied":
    cut = out[1].get("cut")
    if cut is not None:
        inside = set(cut)
        cross = sum(1 for i, (u, v) in enumerate([(0, 3), (3, 1), (1, 4), (4, 2)])
                    if (u in inside) != (v in inside))
        demand = sum({0: 1, 1: 1, 2: 1}[v] for v in cut if v in (0, 1, 2))
        print('   cut', cut, 'cross', cross, 'demand', demand)
        expect('cut strictly deficient', cross < demand, True)

# random large fabric
random.seed(7)
N = 48
edges = set()
while len(edges) < 128:
    u = random.randrange(N)
    v = random.randrange(N)
    if u == v:
        continue
    key = (min(u, v), max(u, v))
    if key in edges:
        continue
    edges.add(key)
LINKS2 = [[u, v, 50] for u, v in sorted(edges)]
parts = sorted(random.sample(range(N), 32))
demands = {v: random.randrange(0, 5) for v in parts}
if sum(demands.values()) == 0:
    demands[parts[0]] = 3
env = [[i, 4] for i in range(128)]
reqs = [
    {"op": "load", "n": N, "links": LINKS2, "bookings": []},
    {"op": "prepare", "id": "p1", "owner": "a", "window": [0, 100], "period": 7,
     "participants": [[v, demands[v]] for v in parts], "envelope": env, "rev": 0},
]
t0 = time.time()
out = run(reqs)
dt = time.time() - t0
print('large fabric: %s in %.2fs' % (out[1]["status"], dt))
if out[1]["status"] == "prepared":
    caps = {i: 7 * 4 for i in range(128)}
    ok, why = check_plan(out[1]["plan"], N, [(u, v) for u, v, _ in LINKS2], caps,
                         parts, demands, 7, {i: 4 for i in range(128)})
    expect('large plan valid (%s)' % why, ok, True)
    print('   plan size: trees=%d routes=%d recipes=%d' % (
        len(out[1]["plan"]["trees"]), len(out[1]["plan"]["routes"]),
        len(out[1]["plan"]["recipes"])))

print()
print('FAILURES: %d' % len(FAIL))
PYEOF
cd /workspace && python3 work/test_network.py
